##### Project general facts

Vista 3 is a masterpiece of modernity and aesthetics, standing as a super high-rise building right at the waterfront in one of most sought-after destinations. Following Abu Dhabi's futuristic approach, this stunning residential tower provides the whole lifestyle of Al Reem Island with its luxury, modernity, and accessible fun for all. Offering a wide range of unit types from one to five-bedroom apartments, Vista 3 embraces the colourful horizon of Al Reem Island, where every day is your best day.

Residents indulge in a resort-like living experience with a comprehensive array of world-class amenities, including a fully equipped gym, a large lobby, a BBQ area, shaded seating areas, landscaped areas, covered parking spaces, large lifts, and both adult and kids' swimming pools. Every element is designed to create a high standard of living where residents can enjoy the luxury, modernity, and accessible fun that defines the Al Reem Island lifestyle.

Every residence at Vista 3 features an inspiring blend of sophisticated finishes and contemporary custom details. Balconies and terraces as per unit plan, kitchen cabinets and countertops, fully tiled bathrooms and guest toilets, double-glazed windows, satellite master antenna and fiber optic connection for high-speed internet, central air conditioning, and showers in each bathroom create a home of pure design aesthetics. Ample natural light and cozy spaces embrace every happy moment, making each residence a sanctuary of elegance and comfort.

##### Location description and benefits

Nestled on Al Reem Island, located off the north-eastern coast of Abu Dhabi, this exceptional location offers the luxury of city life without its hustle and bustle. With three bridges connecting the island to Downtown Abu Dhabi, the waterfront community's accessible location makes it one of the most popular places to live in the UAE capital, situated near the financial district on Al Maryah Island, the cultural hub of Saadiyat Island, and all major roadways.

The location is distinguished by its proximity to key destinations. The Galleria Al Maryah Island, Al Reem Mall with the biggest snow park in the world, Abu Dhabi Mall, Cleveland Clinic Abu Dhabi, and world-class hotels including Four Seasons and Rosewood are all within easy reach. The island is categorized as one of the best communities for living and investment in Abu Dhabi, adopting a "work play live" lifestyle.

For those seeking a residence that embodies modern elegance, waterfront living, and a prime Abu Dhabi address, Al Reem Island delivers an unmatched lifestyle. Its unique combination of strategic connectivity, world-class amenities, and a prestigious location makes it one of the capital's most desirable destinations. This is a place where the future is now closer and the whole world is at your fingertips — serene, connected and effortlessly refined.
